{
  "relevant_files": [
    "sketch/sketch7/context/context.go",
    "sketch/sketch7/context/repo.go"
  ],
  "findings": [
    "context.go implements a Builder that constructs an inference Payload containing sections, messages, and tools. Messages are derived from SessionHistory and trimmed to a MaxMessages limit (default 12) via block-based grouping that preserves tool call/result pairs and user anchors.",
    "repo.go provides RepoContextCache.Summary to generate repository context (file extensions, marker files, top-level entries, git status). It caches results based on InteractionTurnCount and a RefreshEveryTurns interval to avoid redundant scans.",
    "The Section struct defines metadata (Sticky, RetentionMode, RefreshEveryTurns, etc.), but Builder.Build copies sections verbatim without applying this metadata to content generation or filtering.",
    "Builder.Build accepts a workflow parameter but explicitly ignores it (_ = workflow), suggesting incomplete implementation or dead code.",
    "InteractionTurnCount increments for every history record (user, assistant, tool call, tool result), which inflates the count relative to conversational turns and may misalign with RefreshEveryTurns semantics.",
    "scanRepo uses filepath.SkipDir when maxFiles is exceeded, which halts traversal of the current directory and all subdirectories, potentially missing relevant files if distribution is uneven.",
    "gitSummary silently returns empty/false values if git is unavailable or the directory isn't a repository, lacking error propagation or fallback logging.",
    "joinList is defined but unused in context.go, and HashContent relies on SHA-1, which is cryptographically weak (though acceptable for non-security hashing).",
    "The default MaxMessages of 12 is quite low for modern LLM context windows and may truncate useful conversation history prematurely."
  ],

    "The reason workflow is passed to Builder.Build but ignored.",
    "Whether the low MaxMessages default (12) is a deliberate constraint for a specific model or cost-saving measure.",
    "How RepoContextCache is instantiated and shared across sessions or agents."
  ],
  "enough_context": true
}

findings: context.go defines a Builder that constructs an inference Payload containing sections, messages, and tools. Messages are derived from SessionHistory and trimmed to a MaxMessages limit (default 12) via block-based grouping that preserves tool call/result pairs and user anchors (context.go:52-70).

trimMessages groups messages into blocks to keep tool exchanges intact, selects the latest coherent tail up to MaxMessages, ensures the latest user anchor is included, and expands leading tool exchanges if needed (context.go:99-130).

repo.go provides RepoContextCache.Summary to generate repository context (file extensions, marker files, top-level entries, git status). It caches results based on InteractionTurnCount and a RefreshEveryTurns interval to avoid redundant scans (repo.go:29-54).
Builder.Build explicitly ignores the workflow parameter (_ = workflow), suggesting incomplete implementation or dead code (context.go:52).

InteractionTurnCount increments for every history record (user, assistant, tool call, tool result), which inflates the count relative to conversational turns and may misalign with RefreshEveryTurns semantics (repo.go:107-119).

scanRepo uses filepath.SkipDir when maxFiles is exceeded, which halts traversal of the current directory and all subdirectories, potentially missing relevant files if distribution is uneven (repo.go:138).
gitSummary silently returns empty/false values if git is unavailable or the directory isn't a repository, lacking error propagation or fallback logging (repo.go:215-233).
joinList is defined but unused in context.go, and HashContent relies on SHA-1, which is cryptographically weak (though acceptable for non-security hashing) (context.go:230, 237).
context_test.go verifies that trimMessages preserves the latest user anchor and coherent tails, dropping intermediate tool calls if they exceed the limit (context_test.go:5-41).
The default MaxMessages of 12 is quite low for modern LLM context windows and may truncate useful conversation history prematurely (context.go:58).

The reason workflow is passed to Builder.Build but ignored.
